batting.name: YBK Jaiswal
batting.dismissal: c Harshit Rana b MM Ali

batting.name: R Parag
batting.dismissal: c Q de Kock b CV Varun

batting.name: PWH de Silva
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b CV Varun

batting.name: SB Dubey
batting.dismissal: c AD Russell b VG Arora

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c A Raghuvanshi b Harshit Rana

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c TU Deshpande b PWH de Silva

balls.text: punches the straight delivery back after backing away and they get one after it deflects off Johnson's left hand. Oh, they come back for the second! Excellent running on the last ball

and his off stump goes for a walk! 135.5kmh, excellent line and length to target top of off after pitching on middle, Archer swings across the line but misses this time, and the off stump goes cartwheeling
outside off with pace on, slapped down to mid-off by Theekshana for a quick single. He was gone by light years if Russell had hit the stumps at the bowler's end
angling away outside off and Archer muscles that down the ground to long-off
muscles that pull along the ground in the same region between long-on and deep midwicket. Two more
out of the screws! Waist high full toss and Archer was waiting for something like that. Smokes that over wide long-on into the stands
oh, Johnson starts with another wide, this time on the off side to Archer
taken at long-on! Last ball of the over, not many runs of it, he goes down the ground off the length ball and doesn't get the distance he wants. A dolly taken by the tall Raghuvanshi
slower ball to Hetmyer at 115.kmh, cutting away from outside off and Hetmyer misses his big swing
140.7kmh, gets pace and throws his hands at the full delivery outside off but he can't quite middle it. Single to cover
full ball after the short ball, he drills it back straight and a bit too straight. Rana gets a hand to it and saves a few

upper cut for six first ball! Who saw that coming?! Short and wide, swinging away a little and the fast bowler knows how to use the pace of the ball to time that extremely well over the deep third boundary

chops on off a full toss! The pressure catches up with Jurel after all those dot balls in the last over. He shuffles to off to slog on the leg side and only manages the inside half of the bat off the low full toss
excellent over from Johnson after those wides at the start. Brings in the ball in towards the stumps, Jurel misses his swing and only gets one off the edge
another dot bal, three in a row. Doesn't get any bat on this one despite going a long way to off to scoop that to leg but the short ball outside off beat him this time

drills that straight into Hetmyer! Full and outside off, smashes back and Hetmyer has absolutely no time to get out of the way. He is also way outside his crease, lost his balance, so he somehow scrambles back into his crease as Johnson picks the ball up
another full and wide ball to Jurel, he crunches to cover again but this time straight to Rahane at cover
better length now, not too short and wide, and he punches it square for one

dropped and goes for four! To be fair to Venky Iyer that was a tough catch and he sprinted to his left from long-off after Hetmyer slapped it down the ground. Iyer even got both hands to it but he didn't land properly at all and put it down. To make it worse for him, it rolls away for dour
oh my, that's way down the off side. Johnson is way off the mark and bangs in another short ball that goes away a long way to off for another wide
goes short and wide to start with, that's a wide

crunched through the covers for four! That spoils the over for Rana after conceding just seven off the first five balls. But he ends with a full and wide ball, and the Test batter in Jurel comes out to drive that beautifully all along the carpet, through the covers
shuffles again to off and this time flicks the low full toss on middle to long leg where Russell tumbles to his left and keeps the ball in with both hands
pace off and wide outside off, short as well, he can only steer it to point
pace off now at 114.8kmh, looked like an offcutter, and Jurel pushes it back
scooped for four! Shuffles away a fair bit to the off side and since fine leg is in the circle, he connects well enough to scoop the ball fine and over the keeper for four
Harshit starts by banging in a short ball and Hetmyer pulls it square for one
full and slow on middle, clipped to leg and Hetmyer wants two but he's sent back by Jurel just in time
lunges forward this time for the length ball on leg, defends patiently
short and quick around off, punches it back with a straight bat
much straighter and he works it to leg with his wrists for one
he tries to cut that one wide outside off late but can't clear short third this time
inside edge off the drive on ff side, goes to short fine leg

hands a catch straight to deep third! RR had just started to pick up pace against paced and they lose a wicket. Short and wide, pace off, Dubey goes for an aerial cut and he hands a simple catch to Dre Ress in the deep

a low and wide full toss that should have been a yorker, Dubey goes low and scythes that over the point region because he knows there's no protection in the deep there. Third boundary in the last two overs
the attempted yorker is a low full toss on leg and clipped away easily for one
short of length ball climbs on him and he's a little late on the ball that was at 124.5kmh, but gets a single off the pull towards long-on
with outside off, he swings wildly to leg but only gets an edge to leg for one
123kmh, pace taken off and it's short, pulled away for one
117kmh, slower one outside off, Jurel taps it down to long-on for one
pulls the short ball straight to deep square leg but it reaches him after a bounce
short and angling across, he goes for the ramp but misses
short of length outside off and he steers it towards point for one after calling early

on de Kock's other side now, and off the inside edge which wasn't intentional at all. Pace brings boundaries for RR who get a push in the run rate. Jurel went for the pull against a short ball and only got an inside edge, wasn't far from chopping on, but got four
edged just past the flying Quinton de Kock! Outside off and cutting in, and Jurel dangerously guides it fine, no slip there, and de Kock nearly gets a hand to it to his right
too full and wide this time, and driven away nicely through the covers for one
bit too short and Jurel pounces on that to pull it away with some power in the gap for four. The first boundary in over five overs
rolls his wrists over this one to leg for one off the back foot
beaten! Lovely offbreak on off and enough turn to beat the outside edge of the bat as he tried to defend
he takes a step down quickly and clips it square for one more
goes back for the short of length ball, worked to the leg side for one
hint of width and Jurel taps it late to short third, no time for a run
quicker legbreak rushes to Jurel who is hit on the pad on the back foot but towards the leg side
slightly slower outside off, surprises Dubey a little before he taps it down to long-off
on the pads and clipped to midwicket with a flick
not much turn for the length ball outside off, he defends patiently
coming in with the arm towards the stumps, worked to leg for one

hits top of middle stump! That was beautifully bowled not matter what format he bowled it in. Rana made room, Mooen replied by taking the pace off the ball and pitched it on middle, Rana waited for the turn to steer it to off by opening the face of the bat but the ball turned, kept him guessing and beat him to knock over middle
goes on for almost a squat and swats it from off stump to deep square leg for a quick second run
slog sweeps with the turn and skies it down but falls well short of long-on for one more
waits for the slower one on the pads and nudges to midwicket for one
flat on the stumps and it's clipped to leg for one
Rana dances down for big swing on leg but only manages something off the inner half of the bat for one
pushed back to the bowler off the front foot. Halfway through the innings and KKR well on top.
Hasaranga's promotion ends early. He cleared his front leg and slogged, and ended up spooning the skiddy delivery to mid-off. RR are sinking now
falls just short of the diving fielder at short fine leg! Rana brought out the reverse swat and top-edged it, Rana moved to his right and dived but could not get there in time
tries to go big down the ground but ends up slicing the ball over covers
tossed up on off and middle, Hasaranga drives to long on for two this time
moves back and works the ball off the hips for a single into the leg side
Rana stays back and works the ball off his pads for one more. Just nine runs off two Moeen overs, and a wicket.
driven to long on crisply for a single

that's the end of Jaiswal, he hasn't got going at all today. He steps out to the offspinner, looking to clear the long-on boundary, doesn't hit it well, bat turns as he makes contact and he hits it straight to Rana on the boundary. Moeen is more than making up for Narine's absence so far
moves deep into the crease and nudges the ball through midwicket
slog swept to deep square leg with the angle into the left-hander
played back to the bowler from around the wicket, that was chipped in the air a touch
steps forward and defends one that comes into him from around the wicket

that's miles in the air! And when it comes down it lands mid-pitch and in QDK's gloves! Parag aimed down the ground for another six and miscued the delivery that moved away from him. QDK did well, pulling off his helmet and judging that high catch to perfection
a fuller and slower ball on off and middle, played into the covers gently
too short and that's in the first tier! A freebie for Parag who rocks back and pulls with power over deep midwicket
cut off the back foot towards deep point for one more, that was the googly, maybe
think that was the one that goes away from the right-hander, played towards long on for a single
pushed through wicket for a single, just the five runs off that over. KKR will be thrilled with that
shortish ball, Jaiswal gets down on one knee and swats it away to deep square leg ... could have placed that one better
bowled flat and quick on a wicket to wicket line, played into the leg side for a single
steps out and muscles the ball towards deep midwicket ... Jaiswal's not yet looking fluent
an appeal for lbw after Jaiswal misses the slog sweep, that's missing leg stump
nudged off the front foot into the leg side
a full toss this time and puts it away! Free loot. Jaiswal gets under it and hits it hard over the long-off boundary
full and straight at the stumps, Jaiswal drives hard but can't find the gap at cover
Jaiswal backs away outside leg to make room, Arora follows him with a yorker and beats the bat
played towards point for a single
that is some timing! Parag plays a lofted checked-drive and makes terrific contact, sending the length ball soaring over the straight boundary. Mid-on was back but batters don't care anymore
wide ball outside off, Parag chases and misses

dropped! Jaiswal getting a fair bit of luck this innings. He was looking to hit the length ball through the off side but made contact with the inside of his bat and chipped it back towards the bowler, Rana had to reach for it above his head and could not hold on
first slower ball of the day, I think. Jaiswal gets beaten by the change of pace as he pokes outside off
short of a length angling into the hips, nudged through square for a single ...
played back to the bowler, defence with bat and front pad close together to a fuller ball

short of a length on a wicket to wicket line, Parag swings across and makes great contact, one hand comes off the bat during the follow through as he watches the ball sail over the square leg boundary
cut off the back foot towards cover
stays in his crease and plays a good length ball through point to get going
leg stump knocked back! Samson steps out and makes room towards leg to hit on the off side, yorks himself and that's the end of that.
another close call for Jaiswal ... hits the ball to cover where Moeen slides and saves and fires the throw at the striker's end
Jaiswal moves forward and towards leg to try and make room to hit the ball on the off side, Arora follows him and cramps him up, ends up digging it out towards cover
full on the pads, Samson leans across and chip-flicks it towards deep square leg, he'll feel that he missed out on punishing that one
this time he moves across his stumps towards the off side and tries to flick a ball that's strayed down leg side
Samson backs away towards the leg side well before the bowler releases, and then lofts a length ball over the covers for a boundary ... he's trying to make room because of the swing into him
good length and straight, pushed into the covers from the crease
that's high and very far! Johnson pitches one in Jaiswal's swinging arc, he gets under it and slams it over the deep midwicket boundary for the first six of the innings
Jaiswal tries to cut off the back foot but is beaten by a short of a length ball that gets big on him
good length on middle and off, no room to work with this time and Samson plays it with a closed face to midwicket
quick one cramps Jaiswal for room and he mis-times the swivel pull towards short fine, where Varun fumbles and allows the single
full ball and Jaiswal gives it a thump down the ground, hits it well enough to beat the diving Russell to his left at mid off .. that was 144 kph
nudged off the back foot into the off side for another quick single

direct hit at the striker's end and Jaiswal was a goner! Samson cut the ball to point and took off, Ramandeep got to the ball quickly and Jaiswal was barely in the frame when the ball missed the stumps
lines up the good length ball and tries to hit through the line, manages to clear mid-on but Rahane chases the ball down and prevents the boundary
stays in his crease once again and waits for the ball to swing back into him, knocking it into the covers
gets the ball to bend in from outside off stump, Samson meets it by staying in his crease and playing it into the off side. Big swing
Jaiswal steps out to a short of a length ball and nudges off his hips into the leg side
too full and too wide outside off, Samson uses the width and opens the face of his bat to steer the ball behind point and in front of deep third ... that flew off the bat
cracking ball, squares Samson up as he's caught on his crease with late swing away from the right hander, QDK dives to his right to take it
good length, angling across the right hander from over the wicket, Samson stays in his crease and pushes away from his body, playing the ball into the covers
this ball jags back into the left hand from a good length, Jaiswal gets an inside edge on to the pad and they scamper through for a single
short of a length outside off with some nip away off the pitch, Jaiswal tries to punch off the back foot but is beaten
Jaiswal gets a lucky break first ball! that was banged in short and he went for the pull and top edged it high into the night sky ... it falls just short of the boundary behind the keeper
smoked over long-on and de Kock finishes it off in style! Archer finally bowls one straight but there's no respite as De Kock middles that straight down the ground and that's the game for tonight
RR and Archer are all over the place now. This is a wide way down the leg side now, and Jurel does well to get his right glove to it
slow, wide, and full. And so wide it's called a wide

launched over fine leg for six now! This is getting over quickly. Another short ball angling in and this time de Kock lofts it somewhat like Klaasen - bottom to top - behind square to land it in the stands
he bangs it in to start with and de Kock is looking so good he can only middle those pulls now. In the big gap over and wide of mid-on for four
drifting into the pads again, nudged to short fine leg and this time de Kock responds for the single Raghuvanshi has taken off for quickly
poor delivery down the leg side, past the sweep, past the pads, past the keeper for five wides. And Theekshana's shake of the head sumps up RR's show tonight
full on off and that's lofted beautifully over the bowler for one
on the pads now from wide of the crease, clipped away for one

loud appeal, not given, Run out chance and that's also missed. It's all happening here, as they say. And at the end of it all, Parag takes the review for lbw. De Kock missed his reverse sweep and was hit on the knee roll of the front pad, and the impact is well outside off stump. Raghuvanshi ran a long way down the pitch but de Kock had sent him back, and had the throw been more accurate or if Theekshana was standing at the stumps, he was gone
quite tight and flat on off stump, he defends to off for a quick one
drifting down leg but it takes the pad on the way for a leg bye to square leg
he waits for the length ball angling in and taps to point for an easy single
offcutter outside off, quite slow at 116kmh which gives the batter time to stay back and punch it down to long-on
classy straight drive for the full delivery and that's hit so straight it hits the stumps at the other end
on length on off this time, pushes to cover point for one
beaten outside off as de Kock ends up defending just inside the line for the length ball
he starts with an offcutter way outside off, it was going for a wide, but de Kock decides to scythe that away after really reaching out for it and gets a boundary over backward point
pauses just a bit in his delivery like Ashwin, but when he deliveries Raghuvanshi smacks him back over the bowler's head for a cracking four
quick, flat and wide at 95.1kmh, swatted down to the right of long-off
crunches that off the back foot from outside off to deep point. One more
well outside off, eases back and pushes that past cover point for one
turning into the batter towards middle, clipped down to long-on for one more
starts slow and wide, it's slapped back with a big swing past Rana's right hand
short, wide and angling away, de Kock slices it nicely for one to deep point
aims for the block hole, ends up a low full toss on the pads and it's flicked away for one
full on off, smashes back to the bowler and they get one after it deflects off Sandeep's hands
short again, and it'll take a lot from Sandeep to trouble the tall Raghuvanshi with a bouncer. He pulls is down into the ground for one
goes for the reverse scoop on off, but that goes off the edge of the bat just over short fine leg, on the other side and they get one. Was a slower one at 115kmh
short and straight, lofted over midwicket in the air for one
full and wide, de Kock reaches out and slams it down the ground straight back, between long-on and log-off and they make it back for the second
gets down for the fullish ball on middle and sweeps it away behind square for one
flat legbreak on middle and tucked to leg easily for one
drilled back all along the carpet for four! Too short to Raghuvanshi and too full to QdK. And they both put it away in the gap, this time down the ground
goes back for the legbreak outside off, lets it turn, and taps to off for a single
rocks back in the crease and he gets under that short ball nicely to pull that very well over wide mid-on for four in the wide gap
takes the pace off a long way, at 78.2kmh, and it takes the toe end of the bat after the pull shot. Only a single down the ground
comes down while making some room and eases that into the covers for one
quite slow outside leg and takes it on the pad past the inside edge
he reaches out for the ball well outside off with his long arms and middles the slog sweep to deep midwicket
much slower on leg and it's gently clipped square for one. Off the pad though
starts with a short one and that's slammed over midwicket for six more! de Kock looking really good. Rocks back in the crease and hammers it away off the middle
on the back foot this time for the length ball towards off, clips it to leg for one more
swiped away for six over wide long-on and that's his fifty off 36 balls! Pitched up slightly towards middle and leg and de Kock pounces on that to smash it into the stands with a big swing
coming in with the arm towards leg, clips it away for one more
flat legbreak on leg stump, whips it away square for one
lunges forward to push the ball down the ground and a dive to his left from a straight midwicket can't stop the single

and he strikes first ball of his second spell! He starts with a wrong'un which Rahane skies off his sweep, and Tushar Deshpande takes a good catch while running towards square leg where he settles under it nicely

given lbw this time, a late decision from the umpire, and will de Kock review? He does. Skidded into the left-hander from around the wicket and struck the front pad just above the knee roll after he missed the pull. That's going down, missing leg stump with the angle from around the wicket. De Kock carries on batting.
hit off the front foot to long on for a single
leans forward and taps the ball into the gap between long on and deep midwicket, placed it well and a fumble in the deep allows the second
he's hit this one sweetly, too short from Theekshana and Rahane pulls it over the square leg boundary
huge slog across the line and misses it completely, the ball whizzes past off stump into the keeper's gloves

huge appeal for lbw but the umpire is unmoved! Review taken! That was quick and straight from Theekshana and hit Rahane flush on the front pad after he missed the push to midwicket with a slightly closed face. Going down leg side? No inside edge but might be umpire's call at best. Nope. it's missing leg. RR lose a review.
punched off the back foot to long off for a single, six singles off that over
tight wicket to wicket line and length, de Kock goes back and taps the ball towards midwicket
goes back quickly and cuts one that's not that short through point
nudged off the toes towards square leg
short outside off, with width, Rahane goes back and cuts to deep point
cut hard off the back foot through covers for just a single

the length is too short again, giving Rahane time to just stay back and punch the ball in the air over cover and into the gap on the boundary ... not a great start from Hasaranga outside the powerplay
pitches on leg and turns across the left-hander, de Kock nudges off the front foot through midwicket and there's a loud call of NO after the single is completed
punched off the back foot through covers
that was so slow that Rahane had nearly finished his pull shot before the ball thudded into his thigh
short again and de Kock swats the ball flat towards deep midwicket, gets to Hetmyer on the first bounce
Hasaranga starts with a long hop which de Kock waits for and pulls to the fine leg boundary ... a horrible ball to start
played off the back foot through the off side for one more ... two economical overs from the captain
dropped short but the bounce is a bit low, Rahane goes back and pulls through square leg
nice drift and turn into the right-hander, forcing another defensive shot from Rahane
gets on to the front foot to defend one that drifts into him
punched off the back foot to long on for a single

Moeen ticks along with a single through covers, but what's happened at the non-striker's end? He wanted the second run and set off, but was sent back by de Kock. Parag collects the throw from the deep and breaks the stumps with Moeen short of his crease
tries to cut the ball but gets a bottom edge into the ground, Sandeep is keeping the ball quite wide outside off, denying de Kock that swinging arc ... only 40 runs off the powerplay.
short of a length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, de Kock reaches for it wide outside off and slaps it to mid off
full ball, on the pads, and de Kock helps himself to a boundary ... such a crisp flick off the toes, perfect timing
hit hard down the ground but mid on moves to his right and cuts it off
lots of width outside off, de Kock has to reach out for it and the ball stops on him a bit as he hits it to cover, that was in the air for a while
starts with a slower one on a wicket to wicket line, Moeen plays it towards long on
nudged off the pads for a single to finish the over ... Parag got through that one rapidly
makes room by moving towards leg and hits the ball through cover, mis-timed that one
played towards square leg, he tired to give that a whack but got the inside edge instead
steps out, gets to the pitch of the ball and golf-swings it just over the leaping Archer at mid-on for a boundary
blocked watchfully on the front foot again, Parag is slowing it up
tossed up on off stump with some turn away from the left-hander, defended on the front foot
played to mid on and they run a quick single
worked off the pads in front of square for one more
nudged off the pads through the leg side
what happened there? The ball seemed to grip on the pitch and turn away from the left-hander, de Kock fended at it and spooned the ball in the air towards cover
oh he's striking them beautifully tonight! Plants his front foot forward and across and launches the slow sweep over the deep square leg boundary, just clears it
jams down at a wicket to wicket ball and gets an inside edge on to the leg side
steered to third man for a single, that six has spoiled Archer's figures just a bit but he's looked much better tonight
short of a length ball and it's been dispatched over the cow corner boundary, de Kock was quick to go back and he had the time and room to swing his arms freely
short of a length and rapid outside off, de Kock lets it go
short ball, miscued pull, and the top edge falls safely just beyond the 30-yard circle at square leg. 149 kph
fuller ball on off stump, de Kock stays in his crease and opens the face to steer the ball behind point
short and wide, QDK stays back and cuts the ball hard and fast behind point, 142kph and it disappears to the boundary just as fast
defended on the front foot on the leg side, tight start from the Royals
angled into the leftie from around the wicket, pushed to wide mid on for a single
floated up outside off, inviting the drive from the left-hander, de Kock obliges and the ball spins away to beat the bat
bowled slower and fuller on off stump, de Kock drives to point
dragged down short and that's easy for QDK, swivels and pulls the ball between short fine and square leg
defended on the leg side, Jurel sprints to the ball to collect
a fuller ball at the stumps, Moeen stays in his crease and plays towards mid-off ... Archer makes a cracking start after conceding 76 in his previous game against SRH
short of a length just down leg side, Moeen gets off his toes and fends, misses ...there's a small appeal for caught behind but the umpire signals wide ... no review taken
wide outside off again, Moeen goes after it with a big drive and connects with nothing
strays down leg side this time and Jurel does well to dive to his right and make a one-handed stop
bat on ball finally, stays in his crease and pushes a straighter one towards  backward point
145 koh, Archer is cranking it up against his England team-mate ... short of a length, pitching outside off and seaming way, Moeen is beaten three times in a row
has a slash at a fuller and wider ball that moves away again and misses .. that was 146 kph
serious heat on that one, the speed gun shows 139kph but that looked much quicker. Pitched on a length and seamed away from the left-hander, whizzing past Moeen's poking bat
